blocks.text: Joshua 20 contains 9 verses. It opens with: And Jehovah spake unto Joshua, saying, It concludes with: These were the appointed cities for all the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them, that whosoever killeth any person unwittingly might flee thither, and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood, until he stood before the congregation. Supplied contextual evidence for this passage adds: Joshua moves from succession and entry through campaigns to land allotment, tribal unity, farewell, and covenant renewal.
